case.name: UGADA
case.summary: The UGADA trunkline: a wet sour gas-condensate line at 52.6 C and 96.4 bar absolute, CO2 0.0418 and H2S 0.00061 mole fraction, pH 4.86, 2.73 m/s in a 0.2545 m line, a 92 percent inhibitor at 87 percent availability, a 3.81 mm allowance with 0.94 mm consumed against a 25 year design life. It screens mixed, mass transfer controlled, below its film onset and binding on the allowance; moderate film risk at 7 m/s, stripped at 9.5 m/s.
